description: This file defines the Cookie class used for managing HTTP cookies within the Goteo application. It includes methods for setting, retrieving, deleting, and checking cookies, and is tightly coupled with Symfony's HTTP Foundation components.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: A utility class for managing HTTP cookies, including setting, retrieving, deleting, and checking existence of cookies, with support for path and domain configuration.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes the cookie management with Symfony's Response and Request objects.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the path attribute for cookies.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Derives the domain name from the main URL configured in the application.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a value in a cookie with optional TTL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from cookies by key.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a cookie with a specific key exists.
